assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary uses provisional polygon derived from announcement text. Official CAD/GIS boundary not yet publicly available.
assumptions.impact: All area calculations, ratios, and spatial claims are provisional and must be recalculated when official boundary is released.

assumptions.statement: Temporal programming (multiple uses of same space at different times) is technically feasible with current IoT, sensor, and scheduling technology.
assumptions.impact: Core design concept depends on AI scheduling system; implementation requires validation through pilot testing at priority nodes.

assumptions.statement: Community acceptance of time-shared public spaces can be achieved through phased introduction and participatory design.
assumptions.impact: Phase 1 focuses on low-friction temporal programs (markets, fitness) before introducing more complex scheduling in later phases.

assumptions.statement: 9 east-west suture crossings are placed at locations where existing or planned road connections cross the railway park corridor. Exact positions require survey confirmation.
assumptions.impact: Node positions are conceptual; actual crossing feasibility depends on traffic engineering, utility conflicts, and land ownership.

assumptions.statement: Approximately 450,000 residents in ~70 communities adjacent to the corridor would benefit from improved east-west connectivity.
assumptions.impact: Population estimate used for demand modeling and persona development; requires census verification.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection zones along the railway corridor allow for interface improvements (ramps, lighting, signage) without violating conservation requirements.
assumptions.impact: Physical interventions at heritage-sensitive nodes (especially Node 07) require heritage impact assessment.

assumptions.description: 2026年京张遗址公园建成开放作为本方案的背景事实前提
assumptions.basis: 来自征集公告项目背景描述及公开新闻报道；征集公告以'京张铁路遗址公园9公里于2026年8月建成开放'为项目背景
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: 若公园实际开放时间或建设范围不同，缝合节点的设计前提和空间条件需重新评估
assumptions.resolution: 以组织方正式确认的公园竣工验收文件为准

assumptions.description: 公园两侧社区数量和受影响人口为设计假设推算值
assumptions.basis: 基于海淀区统计年鉴2023公开数据中廊道沿线街道（清华园、五道口、中关村、北下关、北太平庄、花园路）常住人口合计推算
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: 不影响空间设计逻辑，仅影响规模表述的精确度
assumptions.resolution: 通过社区普查或街道统计确认精确数量
